name: Ankus
body:
Source Melee Tactics Toolbox pg. 19
Statistics
Cost 8 gp Weight 5 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type P; Special disarm, trip
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Blades, Heavy
Description
Also known as an elephant goad, this tool consists of a 2- to 3-foot rod ending in a spearhead and a backward-facing hook. Traditionally used to train and direct large animals, the ankus can be used as a weapon in a pinch.
